name: 64123 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64123 (Kansas City) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64123 (Kansas City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64123 (Kansas City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
